description: Source code defining classes and functions for documentation processing, including classes for Documentation, Class, Member, and Type, as well as functions for parsing types, processing code groups, and patching links within documentation nodes.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Manages a collection of classes, supports merging, filtering by language, indexing, link rendering, and source code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a documented class with members, properties, methods, events, and associated metadata. Supports filtering, sorting, cloning, and visiting members.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as method, property, or event, with metadata, type, arguments, and documentation spec. Supports filtering, cloning, and visiting.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type with parsing, cloning, filtering, and deep property extraction capabilities.
